_comment: Copy this to canvas.config.json and fill in your school's values. Every setting can also be given as an environment variable (see the README). Defaults are Fontys; change them for your Instructure Canvas + Drieam Portflow setup.
_portflow_launch_url: The Canvas external-tool launch URL for the Portflow/Portfolio nav item. Open Canvas, click the Portfolio item, and copy the URL it launches from (looks like .../external_tools/<id>?launch_type=global_navigation&toolId=portfolio-<id>).
_ntfy_topic: Optional. A ntfy.sh topic for a push summary after --apply --ntfy. Leave empty to disable.
_feedpulse: Optional. Only needed for the feedpulse command. Find the course and tool ids in the FeedPulse launch URL in Canvas: .../courses/<course>/external_tools/<tool>.
